dataset_name: Selected benchmark bond yields: 2-year, 5-year, 10-year and long-term
description: Daily mid-market yields on selected Government of Canada benchmark bonds at 2-year, 5-year, 10-year and long-term maturities. The hub uses them for the level and slope of the yield curve, which signal financing conditions and recession risk.

licence.name: Bank of Canada Terms of Use
licence.conditions: Free to use, copy and distribute. Attribute the Bank of Canada as the source and indicate any changes. Bank of Canada exchange rates are for statistical and analytical purposes only, not for executing trades.

access: Public. Free, no account or API key required. The Bank's terms prohibit circumventing its request limits.
retrieval_method: Bank of Canada Valet REST API: observations/{series}/json returns the full history of the requested series together with each series' label, description, unit and frequency. The response is stored unchanged as the raw file.
frequency_basis: declared by Bank of Canada (Business daily)
update_frequency: business daily; end-of-day yields, posted with a lag (complete by the next morning)
refresh_schedule: 11:30 ET on business days, for the previous day (CRON_TZ=America/Toronto)

reproducibility_rating.basis: the latest raw data has been retrieved once; a retrieval with the same checksum on another day confirms it

quality_notes: 6463 rows in raw file; 25849 rows in processed file (Canada). Missing values: 0 of 25849 observations have no value (0.0%): none. Validation passed. Notes (INFO, see validation): period_change, metadata_completeness.
known_limitations: The Bank publishes no revision policy for these series. Yields on selected benchmark Government of Canada bonds, not constant-maturity yields: a series can jump when the Bank moves the benchmark to a newly issued bond. A few dates (e.g. 2006-09-04) have fewer than four tenors. Not published on market holidays
